currentRoundInspection.title: Linlithgow Palace
currentRoundInspection.status: Two inspected photographs and standard viewer data used for individual authoring; current QA is separate.

pictures.notes: Courtyard seen from above: roofless ranges, hollow unequal round stair/corner towers, narrow arched and rectangular window rhythm, decorated central door surround, wall walks and courtyard fountain. Loch is outside the north side. Linked photo inspected in browser; no image downloaded or used as texture.

Exterior from across the lawn/loch: compact roofless palace, surviving triangular corner gable profiles, unequal hollow towers, tall rectangular facade window rhythm and a projecting bay. The adjacent roofed church, town and park are context, separate from the palace model. Linked photo inspected in browser; no image downloaded or used as texture.
